<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the flavanone product SMILES (a typical flavanone) and the functional group and bond change criteria described: breaking aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, forming ether oxygens, forming C‑C and C‑O bonds, and breaking a C‑O bond. This should return the template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(Cc1ccc(O)cc1)C2CC(O)C3=CC=CC=C3O2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"]
}</action_input>
